## History

At dawn following a grief-stricken night when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feared for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's life, Pacifique spoke with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). He informed her that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) had successfully passed the crisis of his typhoid fever and would recover.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Revelation P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006), [v3 ch.Revelation P9](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0009), [v3 ch.Revelation P16](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0016), [v3 ch.Revelation P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025)_

## Quotes

> "I got de word las’ night dat my fader, he was seeck. It was so stormy dat I couldn’t go den, so I start vair early dis mornin’. I’m goin’ troo de woods for short cut."
>
> — Pacifique — [v3 ch.Revelation P23](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0023)

> "He got de turn las’ night. De doctor say he’ll be all right now dis soon while. Had close shave, dough! Dat boy, he jus’ keel himself at college. Well, I mus’ hurry. De old man, he’ll be in hurry to see me."
>
> — Pacifique — [v3 ch.Revelation P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025)

> "He’s better,"
>
> — Pacifique — [v3 ch.Revelation P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025)

> "Sure,"
>
> — Pacifique — [v3 ch.Revelation P23](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0023)
